Specification: This module specifies a simple user state machine with a single state variable mapping user identifiers to string-valued states. The initial condition sets every user in the parameter set userIDs to the string "INIT", and the next-state action updates one selected user's state to "DONE" using functional override. The file contains no temporal specification, fairness, fault model, assumptions, or proof content; it only defines the initialization predicate and a single state-transition action.
